trailhead: Bird Creek Meadows (Yakama Nation, Mirror Lake road)
oldDirection: From the Bird Creek Meadows area on the Yakama Nation side (tribal recreation permit required; road access seasonal)
proposedDirection: From Trout Lake on SR 141, take the right fork north and follow the Mount Adams Recreation Area signs onto Road 82, about 14.7 miles to Mirror Lake; just past it take the left fork to Bird Lake. The recreation area was closed in August 2026 because of nearby fires, so confirm it is open before you go.
problem: Text is not a drive, and the area is currently closed.

oldDirection: From Index on US-2, turn north onto Index-Galena Road (FR-63) and drive about 16 miles, bearing left at the junction for the final 2 miles of bumpy gravel. Bear left again at the second fork and climb a short hill to the parking area.
proposedDirection: From Index on US-2, turn north onto Index-Galena Road (FR-63) and drive about 16 miles, bearing left at the junction for the final 2 miles of bumpy gravel. Bear left again at the second fork and climb a short hill to the parking area. Since December 2025 flood damage on Beckler River Road (FR-65) has closed access to this trailhead, so check before going.
problem: The trailhead has been reported inaccessible since December 2025 because Beckler River Road is closed for flood damage; the normal drive is otherwise as stated.

oldDirection: From Loomis, drive Toats Coulee Road (FR-39) roughly 22 miles to Long Swamp Campground, then continue about 3 more miles west on FR-39 to the Cathedral Driveway trailhead.
proposedDirection: From Loomis, drive north on County Road 9425 for 2 miles, turn west onto County Road 4066, which becomes Forest Road 39, and follow it about 20 miles to Long Swamp Campground. Continue about 3 miles on Forest Road 3900-300 to the Cathedral Driveway trailhead.
problem: The last 3 miles after Long Swamp are on FR 3900-300, not FR-39.
